column1: # The counts tools/check_text_lints.py measures over the prose of the Parts, each with the maximum it may reach.
# A count above its maximum refuses the check; each number only falls. The worklists are formal/derivation/text_lints/<lint>.tsv.

column3: a number the prose states against the table or tool that states it, and a constant restated with another value
a citation of no section, of a heading with no body, a link whose anchor or Part differs from the number it shows, an empty anchor, a below or above the wrong way
a [CC x.y] link into a Part with no #x.y anchor
a name from the closed list of terms used outside the sense the text has settled
an RFC 2119 keyword in an informative paragraph or example, a lower-case requirement in a normative paragraph, a restatement whose keyword differs from its home's
prose sentences over 40 words in Parts 2 to 8
history words, a ruling, review or refactor, and product, company or repository names
